paragraphs: Trainline’s mission to link millions of travellers to greener journeys mirrors my passion for building tools that unlock hidden value in complex data sets. I thrive on turning intricate problems into actionable insights that drive real-world impact.

Built a tool‑calling LLM agent on AWS Bedrock, using Claude Haiku 4.5, with three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance for a multi‑omics cancer research platform.

Proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Power BI yet.
